context.passage:
Looking for an Apartment? Check Out Moonstone Properties
Moonstone Properties opened its first apartment complex in New York City twenty
years ago and later expanded into Philadelphia and Pittsburgh. This December, we
are opening our fourth Moonstone apartment complex in Baltimore.
Conveniently located at 2 James Street, the complex is a short walk to a public park
grocery store, library, and bus stop. Each of our four buildings has a fitness center an
community room.
Building 1: Next door to the Floral Café. Bicycle storage room.
Building 2: Rooftop vegetable garden. Next to Finlay Park.
Building 3: River view. Private balconies.
Building 4: Close to a playground. Parking garage under the building.
Schedule a tour of our one- or two-bedroom units at www.moonstone.com/baltimore
today!
To:
Aisha Abara <aishaabara@jmail.net>
From:
Suzanna Cohen <scohen@moonstone.com>
Date:
Saturday, January 12
Subject:
Apartment tour
Dear Ms. Abara,
Thank you for completing the inquiry form on our Web site. Per your request, I will meet
you at 10 A.M. tomorrow at the Floral Café to give you a tour of the apartment complex.
We have several vacant units available in each building. If you see an apartment you like,
you can put down a deposit and sign a lease agreement immediately.
You indicated that you need two bedrooms but did not mention whether you preter a
certain building. Please let me know if you do.
Best,
Suzanna Cohen, Leasing Agent
Moonstone Properties
110
Moonstone Apartments Newsletter
Resident Profile: Aisha Abara
Aisha can often be spotted sipping coffee at the Floral Café or enjoying the peaceful
view of the river from her balcony. An avid reader, Aisha visits the library weekly
she also enjoys jogging and tennis when she is not teaching chemistry at Spurlock
High School. We are delighted to welcome Aisha to the Moonstone community.
